module_title: Boilermaker Tools, Equipment, Machines and Materials
title: Trade-Related Machines: Purpose, Terminology, Hazards and Maintenance Awareness
objective: Recognise the purpose, terminology and safety context of trade-related machines without operating them.
safety_boundary: Theory only. No machine setup, operation, adjustment or maintenance procedures are taught.

sections.heading: 1. Machine purpose
sections.body: Trade-related machines perform defined fabrication functions within controlled workshop processes.

sections.heading: 2. Terminology
sections.body: Correct names and terminology help learners understand drawings, instructions, procedures and workplace communication.

sections.heading: 3. Hazards
sections.body: Machines can involve serious mechanical, electrical and material hazards, so operation requires training and authorisation.

sections.heading: 4. Maintenance awareness
sections.body: Inspection and maintenance are controlled workplace activities. Defects or uncertainty must be reported.
